verdict.rationale: Resend's own changelog refers to 'any official SDK' and to capabilities exposed through 'the API, SDKs, CLI, and MCP server'. A hands-on community report praises the breadth and idiomatic quality of the SDKs across languages, including Elixir. missing for 10: in-depth first-party SDK documentation (supported language list, install and usage guides, versioning) in the evidence pack.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can build against official SDKs

citations.quote: Rename a segment from the API, CLI, or any official SDK.
Build custom headless webhook experiences from the API, SDKs, CLI, and MCP server.
I have to say I'm impressed at the breadth of their SDK support (even Elixir) and how idiomatic they seem in each language
